description: This file contains the implementation of the ZoneService interface, specifically the ZoneServiceImpl class, responsible for managing Zone entities including retrieval by code, adding descriptions, and fetching zones by country and language, with caching support.

classes.name: ZoneServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing Zone entities, providing methods for retrieving zones by code, country, and language, and adding descriptions with caching and logging support.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a Zone entity by its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Add a description to a Zone, updating the entity if necessary.

methods.name: getZones (Country, Language)
methods.description: Retrieve a list of zones for a specific country and language, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getZones (Language)
methods.description: Retrieve a map of zones keyed by their code for a specific language, utilizing cache.
